title: Place useFormStatus inside the form it observes
businessContext: Review a focused Next.js application change before it reaches production. The proposed file below contains the defect or unsupported assumption; external application services, where imported, are integration boundaries.
problemStatement: Review the proposed app/submit-button.tsx change. Identify the incorrect framework assumption, propose a minimal corrected implementation, and provide evidence for the selected version scope and its 15/16 differences. Explain the interview variation after solving the base task. This is a framework code review: actual rendering, routing and cache behavior must be checked in a real Next.js build, not a browser function sandbox.
constraints: Preserve the stated user behavior and keep trust boundaries explicit.
Use the selected version’s documented API; do not suppress build/type failures to hide the defect.
Render the button inside a parent action form and delay the action.
Submit via keyboard and confirm pending disables the button.
Render a second independent form and verify statuses remain independent.

alternativeApproaches: It improves feedback but is not a server concurrency guarantee. Use a database constraint, idempotency policy or transactional operation appropriate to the mutation, and test retries from a forged or repeated request.
